title: TAVI — accessible names of the Add Task drawer controls (DOM, build index-7qe5X0Gd.js)
lines: input[text]           name=""   placeholder="Type or pick a subject"   (Subject)
button                name="Choose a record…"                         (Contact Name — same name as Ticket)
button                name="Select"                                   (Status — same name as Priority)
The visible labels (Subject, Ticket, Due Date …) are not linked to the controls (no for/id, no aria-labelledby). Reminder radios (at / before / custom) have no label either.
